text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk on my day off, I ran 
into Mr. C.B. It looked like she was on 
her way somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
, to the sea. It was a pretty sudden 
decision.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was just her usual whims at 
play, but apparently not. It seemed she 
had company this time—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Ace. Katsuragi Ace. She invited me 
out.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo~! CB! Wanna go to the beach!? The 
beach!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The weather's great, so we've got nothing 
to lose!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Or so she said.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was somewhat unexpected. Though it 
might just be my arbitrary impression of 
Mr. C.B., taking up someone else's 
invitation felt rather rare for her.
choice_data_list: Were you in the mood for the sea too, CB?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Before she invited me, I guess I was kind 
of in the mood to go somewhere out in the 
middle of nowhere, like a vast wasteland.
choice_data_list: Does that mean your mood changed?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...How should I put it? Ace just tends to 
hit the jackpot a lot, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you've got that "I have no idea 
what you're talking about" look on your 
face. Hmmm... So basically...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You know how the word for "mood" is 
written with the characters for "spirit" 
and "part"? I don't know the etymology or 
the actual meaning, but it feels like all 
kinds of different feelings exist in 
separate parts.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Besides the me who felt like running 
across a wasteland, there's probably 
another me out there in a completely 
different mood.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And Ace feels like one of those moods of 
mine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's like, every now and then, she manages 
to draw an even bigger jackpot of a mood 
than the one I picked for myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not someone who sways your emotions, but 
someone who draws an even better jackpot 
for you—that kind of presence.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Does that make any sense?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, having a relationship like that 
is...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though they are completely different 
people, it feels like they share a deep 
connection—a truly mysterious bond.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mysterious... I guess so, when you put it 
like that. I've never really thought about 
it, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
By the time I noticed, that was just how 
things were.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, freezing! It soaked right through my 
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I find it enviable. Having someone who can 
lift your spirits even higher must be 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Enviable... huh. Yeah, I can see why 
people might think that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ace never, ever lets me get bored, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, freezing! It soaked right through my 
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone so rare that you couldn't find 
them even if you went looking. A bond that 
must be treasured.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Without exaggerating, I really 
think so too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There are so many fun things I'd never get 
to experience if Ace wasn't around.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, freezing! It soaked right through my 
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You should've taken your shoes off before 
walking in. We don't have towels, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Oh, it really is cold.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you knew that, you should've taken 
yours off too before stepping in!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I just felt like doing it this way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're way more soaked than I am! Hey, 
don't keep walking like that. Take 'em off 
and dry 'em out!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fair enough. The weather's nice, and...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Why don't we just look at the sea and 
take it easy until they dry?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Welp, that's two hours down the drain for 
sure. Guess I'll go grab us some drinks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With no particular goal and rushed by no 
one, a relaxing time—where both of their 
moods aligned perfectly.
